tempoShift.note: tie-breaker only after energy; never double-count

valsShare_milongaShare.rule: last non-null by factor priority (higher wins)

cortinaGenres.rule: weighted union; region pool always included; mood pool overrides

evidenceScale.strong: >=1 large-N peer-reviewed study or meta-analysis, replicated direction
evidenceScale.moderate: peer-reviewed but small-N/correlational or inferred from a neighbouring domain

options.label: Winter
options.notes: Reflective/melancholy preference in cold months; more lyrical vocal tandas; fewer late milongas. Multiply by daylight factor.

options.label: Spring
options.notes: 'Serene' preference: Fresedo, Di Sarli instrumentals, De Angelis valses in the build.

options.label: Summer
options.notes: Arousal preference up but heat factors push down; prefer rhythmic over slow-dramatic energy.

options.label: Autumn
options.notes: Nostalgia window; Troilo-Marino / Di Sarli 50s accepted slightly earlier in the arc.

options.label: Mild / clear
options.notes: Baseline.

options.label: Steady rain
options.notes: Floor fills late: warm-up to 20% of night; lyrical early; longer cortinas tolerated.

options.label: Heat wave (>=30 C outside, room not air-conditioned)
options.notes: Peak cap 80; no milonga tanda in hottest hour; milonga tandas 3 tracks; cortinas 60-90 s for hydration; lyrical peaks (Di Sarli 50s) over rhythmic; D'Arienzo 1950s only after room cools.

options.label: High humidity (RH>=70% at >=24 C)
options.notes: Humidity matters more than the thermometer for sweat evaporation; floors get sticky; avoid fastest valses (>=195 BPM).

options.label: Cold (<=5 C outside; room struggling)
options.notes: Rhythmic warm-up to warm bodies; cortinas 30-40 s so people don't cool down.

options.label: Storm (thunder, wind)
options.notes: Attendance risk: fall back to small-crowd profile; keep loudness headroom.

options.label: < 18 C
options.notes: Rhythmic warm-up; two milonga tandas in first 90 min acceptable; cortinas 30-40 s.

options.label: 18-24 C
options.notes: Baseline; performance-neutral band.

options.label: 24-28 C
options.notes: 3-track milonga tandas; one fewer milonga over the night; cortinas 50-60 s.

options.label: > 28 C
options.notes: Peak cap 80; lyrical peaks; D'Arienzo 1950s milongas once; cortinas 60-90 s; 3-track tango tandas in hottest hour. When set, this replaces weather.heatwave's energy/tempo terms.

factors.label: Time of day / night (local clock of the slot)

options.label: Afternoon practica / milonga de la tarde (14:00-19:00)
options.notes: Post-lunch dip at start: open with clear rhythmic instrumentals (D'Arienzo 1936-38, Rodriguez); more instrumentals; no Pugliese; 30 s cortinas. Use energyShift 0 for a BsAs 'milonga de la tarde' with regulars.

options.label: Early evening (19:00-22:00)
options.notes: Arrival phase; business-hours arousal preference still active.

options.label: Prime night (22:00-00:30)
options.notes: Main build and peak live here.

options.label: After midnight (00:30-02:30)
options.notes: Emotional energy replaces physical: Pugliese / Troilo-Marino / Di Sarli 50s window. Alcohol: cortinas <= 45 s and <= -3 dB.

options.label: Deep night (02:30-04:30)
options.notes: Circadian trough; lyrical long runs; milonga tandas sparse, 3 tracks; one D'Arienzo 1950s milonga as wake-up if floor sags.

options.label: Sunrise marathon slot (04:30-09:00)
options.notes: Hammock set: one gentle peak at ~60% of slot, valses as lifts, Fresedo/Di Sarli/Canaro-Maida/Demare core; no Pugliese vocal; re-ramp +4 in last 45 min for daytime hand-over.

options.label: Monday-Wednesday
options.notes: Earlier end: compress arc; peak at 70% not 80%.

options.label: Thursday
options.notes: Weekly affect nadir; gentler warm-up, don't force a peak.

options.label: Friday
options.notes: TGIF: arrivals come wound-up; warm-up 10% shorter.

options.label: Saturday
options.notes: The dancing day; fullest floor; full arc.

options.label: Sunday
options.notes: Older, traditional crowd (lore); sweet ending = last 15%; Guardia Vieja and Canaro-Maida welcome.

options.label: Regular milonga
options.notes: Baseline.

options.label: Marathon slot, day 1
options.notes: 1935-45 core; >=20 orchestras per 8 h; hammock tandas; Pugliese once per slot; no requests.

options.label: Marathon slot, day 2
options.notes: Cumulative fatigue (sleep debt lowers arousal preference).

options.label: Marathon slot, day 3
options.notes: Cumulative fatigue; more valses, fewer milongas.

options.label: Encuentro milonguero
options.notes: Crowded floor, short steps: vals <= 190, milonga <= 122 quarter BPM; strict cabeceo -> clean cortina gaps; no alternative, no contemporary orchestras; cortinas 30-40 s.

options.label: Festival main milonga
options.notes: Large young room; one contemporary-orchestra tanda in first third; re-ramp after shows with D'Arienzo/Biagi, never a vals; cortinas 40-60 s.

options.label: Practica
options.notes: More instrumentals; longer runs of one style allowed; no Pugliese 50s.

options.label: Wedding / show / mixed non-dancer audience
options.notes: Famous titles only (La Cumparsita, Por una cabeza, El dia que me quieras, Poema, Desde el alma, Bahia Blanca); 3-track tandas; valses high; Piazzolla Libertango/Oblivion allowed for show spot; close with D'Arienzo 1951 Cumparsita.

options.label: Small (< 40 dancers)
options.notes: Floor empties fast: cortinas 20-30 s; 3-track tandas for partner turnover; no Pugliese until >= 60% of expected crowd present.

options.label: Medium (40-150)
options.notes: Baseline; cortinas 45 s.

options.label: Large / packed (> 150 or > 1 couple per 3 m2)
options.notes: Cortinas 60-90 s to clear; steadier pulses (Di Sarli, Rodriguez, D'Arienzo instrumental) over rubato because the ronda jams; valses <= 190.

options.label: Beginners / class night
options.notes: Low complexity: marcato in 4, square phrases, no rubato (Di Sarli 40s, D'Agostino, Rodriguez, Canaro); milongas slow (Canaro <= 110) and 3 tracks; no Pugliese 50s, no Biagi fast valses; beginnerWeight=1.0 in danceability.

options.label: Mixed
options.notes: Baseline; beginnerWeight=0.5.

options.label: Advanced / milongueros
options.notes: Tolerance for rubato, Troilo late, Pugliese twice in 6 h, Laurenz/Malerba colour, Guardia Vieja; cortinas 45-60 s; beginnerWeight=0.2.

options.label: Young (< 35 median)
options.notes: Younger listeners choose more intense music; D'Arienzo/Biagi heavy; festival style.

options.label: Mixed
options.notes: Baseline.

options.label: Senior (55+ median)
options.notes: Spontaneous motor tempo slows with age: lower half of each tempo band; Canaro, Di Sarli, Fresedo, D'Agostino, Tanturi-Campos; slow milongas (Canaro, Di Sarli); no D'Arienzo 1960s.

options.label: Balanced
options.notes: Baseline.

options.label: Leader surplus
options.notes: 3-track tandas for faster partner rotation.

options.label: Follower surplus
options.notes: 3-track tandas; slightly more vals (followers dance vals together more readily).

options.label: Locals / regulars
options.notes: Regional profile applies fully.

options.label: Mixed
options.notes: Region pool plus universally decodable jazz.

options.label: Tourists / international (> 50%)
options.notes: Play the canon (top-200 titles); avoid local-only codes (full-song cumbia breaks, chacarera) unless region=buenosAires; cortinas unmistakably non-tango for everyone.

options.label: Sprung wood / good parquet
options.notes: Baseline; fast valses and milongas fine.

options.label: Laminate / varnished (fast, slippery)
options.notes: Fewer fast milongas (D'Arienzo 50s <= 1); valses <= 190.

options.label: Tile / stone / marble
options.notes: Hard, often slippery; knees tire; avoid fast milongas and Biagi valses; favour lyrical walking tandas.

options.label: Concrete / carpet / sticky
options.notes: 'Getting stuck': pivots hurt; minimise milonga; slower Di Sarli / Fresedo; fewer vals too.

options.label: Outdoor deck / plaza
options.notes: Ambient noise: rhythmic, loud-transfer tracks; Guardia Vieja 78 transfers get lost; cortinas louder, 45-60 s; weather rules apply.

options.label: Small (< 80 m2)
options.notes: Jams quickly; steadier tempos; cortinas 30-45 s.

options.label: Medium
options.notes: Baseline.

options.label: Large hall (> 250 m2)
options.notes: Room to run: D'Arienzo milongas, Biagi valses OK; cortinas 45-60 s.

options.label: Dry (RT < 0.8 s)
options.notes: Staccato reads; rhythmic orchestras shine.

options.label: Moderate (0.8-1.5 s)
options.notes: Baseline.

options.label: Reverberant (> 1.5 s: gym, church, stone)
options.notes: Prefer legato (Di Sarli, Fresedo, Calo, De Angelis valses); avoid fastest staccato; use clearly non-tango cortina timbres; loudness -2 dB.

options.label: Buenos Aires traditional
options.notes: Era 1938-50; two Cumparsitas; long cortinas (45-90 s), same clip all night; chacarera/chamame set late; D'Arienzo share up to 25%; full-song cumbia/salsa breaks 2-3x.

options.label: Europe (marathon / encuentro / milonga)
options.notes: 1935-55; more Guardia Vieja colour; seamless fades; cortinas 30-45 s.

options.label: Istanbul / Eastern Mediterranean
options.notes: Bright, fast; D'Arienzo/Biagi/Rodriguez heavy; cortinas 45-90 s and loud.

options.label: Asia (Seoul / Tokyo / Taipei / Shanghai)
options.notes: Lower arousal baseline in streaming data; highest audio-quality expectations; late Troilo / Di Sarli loved; dramatic valued over rhythmic.

options.label: US / Canada
options.notes: Less era-literate: tolerate vocal-era mixing; 0-2 alternative tandas late; avoid swing cortinas where swing dancers are present; 3-track tandas in beginner-heavy scenes.

options.label: None
options.notes: Baseline.

options.label: Christmas week
options.notes: Sweet major-mode valses (Canaro Desde el alma, Di Sarli Bajo el cielo azul); family/all-ages -> senior-leaning; Christmas songs as cortinas only, never tandas.

options.label: New Year's Eve
options.notes: Hard peak 23:30-23:55 (D'Arienzo/Biagi/Pugliese), Cumparsita at midnight, 5-min break, restart from 'build' at energy 65 with a vals; after 01:00 cortinas short and quieter (alcohol).

options.label: Valentine's Day
options.notes: Apply mood.romantic preset; famous love lyrics (Poema, Nada, Fumando espero, Toda mi vida); emotional rather than physical peak.

options.label: Carnival
options.notes: Two milonga-candombe tandas; festive rhythmic orchestras; one BsAs-style break tanda allowed.

options.label: Short days (< 9 h; high latitude winter)
options.notes: Season shift x1.3; warm, lyrical; longer sweet ending.

options.label: Long days (> 16 h; high latitude summer)
options.notes: Season shift x1.3; arrivals late -> stretch warm-up.

options.label: Equatorial (|lat| < 15 deg)
options.notes: Season shift x0.3 (seasonal amplitude shrinks toward the equator).

options.label: Temperate default
options.notes: Season shift x1.0.

options.label: Event starts before sunset
options.notes: People arrive later; keep warm-up instrumental.

options.label: Romantic
options.notes: valence +, arousal low-mid. Lyrical orchestras + lyrical singers (Di Sarli-Rufino/Podesta, Fresedo-Ray, Canaro-Maida, Calo-Beron, Demare-Miranda, Troilo-Fiorentino, D'Agostino-Vargas, Tanturi-Campos); major-mode titles welcome; emotional peak.

options.label: Energetic
options.notes: valence +, arousal high. D'Arienzo all periods, Biagi, Rodriguez, Tanturi-Castillo, Donato; marcato in 4, strong syncopation, high pulse strength; still >= 1 breathing tanda per 90 min.

options.label: Nostalgic
options.notes: valence mixed, arousal low. Guardia Vieja + early-40s vocal tandas, famous lyrics, Canaro-Charlo/Fama valses, Troilo-Fiorentino, Di Sarli-Rufino; strong pulse + moderate brightness (memory features); sweet ending 20%.

options.label: Playful
options.notes: valence +, arousal mid-high. Milongas (Canaro, D'Arienzo 1937-41, Tanturi-Castillo), Biagi anticipations, Donato humour, Rodriguez-Moreno, De Angelis valses; medium syncopation, square phrases.

options.label: Elegant
options.notes: Di Sarli (both periods), Fresedo, De Angelis, Laurenz, Troilo 41-43; legato, arrastre, clean marcato in 2.

options.label: Dramatic
options.notes: valence -, arousal high. Pugliese (two tandas allowed in 5 h+), Troilo 44-55, Di Sarli 50s, Gobbi, Color Tango once; high LRA, rubato, dense arrangement; every dramatic tanda followed by a vals or rhythmic breather.

axes.danceability: 0-100; readiness of a social dancer to walk to it; canción forced <= 25
axes.difficulty: 0-100; rubato, irregular phrasing, dominant singer, density, fast/slow extremes
axes.arousal: 0..1 perceived activation (loudness, tempo, spectral flux, rhythmic regularity)

tempo.compute: beat tracker + folding per musicology.md s0; cross-check reference durations

cancion.note: tempo irrelevant to danceability; arousal only

marcato.compute: onset-strength energy at 2x pulse vs 1x pulse; or orchestra/era prior

milonga.habaneraRatio: share of 3-3-2 vs straight 4; more 3-3-2 -> difficulty +5, valence +0.05

syncopation.compute: Longuet-Higgins & Lee index on onset grid, or style prior

arrastre.compute: 60-250 Hz energy rise over ~150 ms before beat 1; occurrence rate

variacion.compute: onset-density spike > 2x median in final 15%, high register

lyricalVsRhythmic.compute: sustained-tone energy / percussive onset energy (spectral flux)

singerRole.compute: vocal activity ratio (VAR) via source separation
singerRole.cancionRule: VAR > 0.6 and rubato -> cancion, danceable <= 25, never in a tanda

dynamics.compute: EBU R128 loudness range (LRA, LU); short-term loudness std

keyMode.compute: Krumhansl/Temperley key profiles on the A part; verify with sheet key

arrangementDensity.compute: spectral flatness + simultaneous pitched streams, or orchestra prior

pulseClarity.note: strongest predictor of beginner danceability and memory salience

transferQuality.compute: label tier, SNR, speed check vs reference duration
transferQuality.note: affects loudness normalisation and arousal; not energy class

tango.emotional: base_emo + vocal*8 + singerDrama*6 + minor*5 + rubato(8|14) + dense*6 + lraHigh*6 + arrastre*6 + era_emo
tango.danceability: 70 + pulseClarity*0.3 + square*6 + marcato4*8*beginnerWeight - rubato*12 - dominantSinger*8 - abs(bpm-126)*0.5
tango.difficulty: base_diff + rubato*14 + irregularPhrase*10 + dominantSinger*6 + dense*4 + arrastre*6 + syncHigh*8 + (bpm<112)*8 + (bpm>138)*6

cancion.engineRule: never inside a tanda; homenaje single or show spot only

eraTable.note: Quarter-note BPM per musicology.md s0. Typical tanda means; orchestra_profiles.json overrides.

eras.label: Golden mid (singers become stars; 1941 peak)
eras.marcato: in4 (Tanturi, D'Arienzo-Maure) and in2 (Di Sarli, Troilo)

eras.label: Post-golden
eras.marcato: in4 very fast (D'Arienzo 60s) or in2 slow (Di Sarli 56-58)
